cards.headline: Environmental Impact of Cataract Surgery Packs

source.title: Environmental Impact of Cataract Surgery Packs: Benchmarking Real-World Practice Through the ESCRS SIDICS Platform.
source.publisher: Journal of cataract and refractive surgery
source.excerpt: The carbon footprint of most cataract surgery packs submitted to SIDICS exceeded that of the ESCRS Benchmark Pack, with drapes and gowns accounting for most pack-related emissions. Standardization and selective optimization of these high-impact components may reduce emissions, while still considering patient safety.

cards.headline: Deep Learning Model for Image-Based Classification of Four Keratitis Categories

source.title: Deep Learning Model for Image-Based Classification of Four Keratitis Categories.
source.excerpt: We developed a DL model for image-based classification among 4 selected keratitis categories. Further validation in broader clinical populations, including other corneal diseases and normal corneas, is required before clinical application.

cards.headline: Legal challenges and regulatory responses in online medical consultation

source.title: Legal challenges and regulatory responses in online medical consultation.
source.excerpt: Such rules can define the nature of services and platform liability under the overarching principle that standards should be tailored to the operational model.

source.title: Völkerschau der „Amazonen von Dahomey“ 1888–1903
source.excerpt: Die Völkerschau der „Amazonen von Dahomey“ 1888–1903 war eine 15 Jahre andauernde Völkerschau-Tournee, bei der zwischen 1888 und 1903 eine Gruppe von wechselnd 20 bis 80 meist aus der damaligen deutschen Kolonie Togo stammenden Personen in über siebzig europäische Städten zur Schau gestellt wurde. Die Völkerschau wurde von einer Reihe verschiedener Impresarios durchgeführt.

source.title: Artificial intelligence in odontology education.
source.excerpt: AI shows potential as a complementary resource in dental education. Its integration should remain pedagogically guided and ethically supervised while future research establishes its educational effectiveness through standardized and longitudinal evaluation.

cards.headline: Harnessing single-cell omics for farmed animal improvement and human health

source.title: Harnessing single-cell omics for farmed animal improvement and human health.
source.publisher: Journal of animal science and biotechnology
source.excerpt: Finally, we highlight future directions toward population-scale single-cell omics, AI-driven virtual cells/tissues, and genotype-cell/tissue-trait frameworks, which are expected to transform biological discovery, enable better design of veterinary medicines and human therapeutics, as well as accelerate sustainable farmed animal improvement and precision medicine.

source.title: Entstalinisierung
source.excerpt: Die Entstalinisierung war eine Reihe von politischen, wirtschaftlichen und gesellschaftlichen Reformen seitens der Staats- und Parteiführung der Sowjetunion, die sich gegen den bisherigen Stalinismus richteten.

source.title: One step beyond CASA Systems: Artificial intelligence (AI) and deep learning (DL) for canine sperm analysis (CSA).
source.excerpt: This current article highlights the technological transition from fragmented, parameter based motility assessments toward holistic, pattern oriented sperm evaluations, evaluating its ultimate implications for fertility prediction and routine canine veterinary andrology with one step beyond of conventional CASA with deep learning and artificial intelligence.

cards.headline: Artificial intelligence for Traditional Chinese Medicine classic formula development

source.title: Artificial intelligence for Traditional Chinese Medicine classic formula development: a technology readiness assessment using metabolic syndrome as a case study.
source.excerpt: Algorithmic advances will remain in an incomplete information space until knowledge infrastructure gaps are closed.

source.title: Interparlamentarische Union
source.excerpt: Die Interparlamentarische Union ist eine 1889 gegründete internationale Vereinigung von Parlamenten, mit dem Ziel der Sicherung des Friedens, der Förderung des Demokratieverständnisses in allen Teilen der Welt und der Wahrung der Menschenrechte. Sie wurde von William Randal Cremer aus Großbritannien und Frédéric Passy aus Frankreich ins Leben gerufen.

cards.headline: Artificial intelligence in glaucoma diagnosis and management

source.title: Artificial intelligence in glaucoma diagnosis and management: a systematic review of the past decade (2015-2026).
source.excerpt: Prospective multicenter validation using diverse populations, explainable and reproducible models, standardized evaluation, and integration into clinical workflows are essential before widespread implementation.

source.title: Artificial intelligence in allergology: A Position Paper of the German Society of Allergology and Clinical Immunology (DGAKI), German Academy of Allergy, Clinical Immunology and Environmental Medicine (AeDA) and German Society of Pediatric Allergology and Environmental Medicine (GPA): Part 2.
source.excerpt: Together with Part 1, this paper defines AI's role, outlines methodological foundations, highlights initial applications, and provides a framework for evidence-based, patient-oriented integration requiring human oversight, scientific validation, and regulatory alignment.

source.title: Artificial intelligence in dermatophytosis: Toward better clinical diagnosis and management.
source.excerpt: With further improvement in research quality and the accumulation of clinical application experience, AI is expected to become increasingly integrated into dermatophytosis management workflows.

cards.headline: Leveraging artificial intelligence for livestock genetics and breeding

source.title: Leveraging artificial intelligence for livestock genetics and breeding.
source.publisher: Journal of animal science and biotechnology
source.excerpt: From a livestock genetic improvement perspective, the key value of AI will lie in integrating AI-generated inputs, including improved phenotyping and biological insights, into practical breeding decisions through statistical modeling.

cards.headline: Unser Herr, lasse unsere Herzen nicht abschweifen, nachdem Du uns rechtgeleitet hast …

source.title: Sure Ali 'Imran, 3:8
source.excerpt: ويقولون: يا ربنا لا تَصْرِف قلوبنا عن الإيمان بك بعد أن مننت علينا بالهداية لدينك، وامنحنا من فضلك رحمة واسعة، إنك أنت الوهاب: كثير الفضل والعطاء، تعطي مَن تشاء بغير حساب.

cards.arabic: رَبَّنَا لَا تُزِغْ قُلُوبَنَا بَعْدَ إِذْ هَدَيْتَنَا وَهَبْ لَنَا مِن لَّدُنكَ رَحْمَةً ۚ إِنَّكَ أَنتَ ٱلْوَهَّابُ
cards.translation: Unser Herr, lasse unsere Herzen nicht abschweifen, nachdem Du uns rechtgeleitet hast, und schenke uns Erbarmen von Dir aus. Du bist ja der unablässig Schenkende.
cards.reflection: Was nimmst du heute aus diesem Vers mit?
cards.body: The Mutashabihat and Muhkamat Ayat: Allah states that in the Qur'an, there are Ayat that are Muhkamat, entirely clear and plain, and these are the foundations of the Book which are plain for everyone.

cards.headline: Unser Herr, Du wirst die Menschen gewiß zu einem Tag versammeln …

source.title: Sure Ali 'Imran, 3:9
source.excerpt: يا ربنا إنا نُقِرُّ ونشهد بأنك ستجمع الناس في يوم لا شَكَّ فيه، وهو يوم القيامة، إنَّك لا تُخلف ما وعَدْتَ به عبادك.

cards.arabic: رَبَّنَآ إِنَّكَ جَامِعُ ٱلنَّاسِ لِيَوْمٍ لَّا رَيْبَ فِيهِ ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَا يُخْلِفُ ٱلْمِيعَادَ
cards.translation: Unser Herr, Du wirst die Menschen gewiß zu einem Tag versammeln, an dem es keinen Zweifel gibt. Allah bricht nicht, was Er versprochen hat.
cards.reflection: Was nimmst du heute aus diesem Vers mit?
cards.body: The Mutashabihat and Muhkamat Ayat: Allah states that in the Qur'an, there are Ayat that are Muhkamat, entirely clear and plain, and these are the foundations of the Book which are plain for everyone.
